summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier) and the SHACLPathError exception, and test/test_extras/test_shacl.py with parametrized valid and invalid cases, non-node input checks, a cyclic rdf:rest check, and a graph-unchanged check. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (43 passed) under the prepared venv. Nothing was committed. Not verified: black, isort, and mypy are not installed in the shared venv, so only line length (under 88 columns) was checked by hand. The non-node guard after a Node-typed parameter may trigger mypy's warn_unreachable and needs a type-checker run.
